title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-maya-patel-2026-03-09
content:
Weekly dedicated capacity sync - prep notes (Maya)

Meeting: Dedicated Capacity Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-03-09
Attendees (expect): Jordan, Priya, Evan, SRE on-call (TBD), Sales rep for incoming renewal (if available)
Location: #eng-dedicated Slack + Zoom

Goals for this week
- Align on 90-day GPU forecast across Hosted + Dedicated customers.
- Decide on reservation adjustments for Q2 (recommendation below).
- Confirm autoscaling policy changes for burst/backfill windows.
- Surface any risk (hardware shortages, region capacity) and mitigation.

Quick summary (current state)
- Total dedicated pool (global): 120 x A100-equivalent GPUs provisioned.
- Reserved (committed): 82 GPUs across 7 customers (up 6 from last week).
- Average utilization on committed pools: 68% during peak hours (18:00-02:00 UTC).
- Spot/burst usage (shared pool): avg 22% of remaining capacity; high variance day-to-day.
- Outstanding scaling requests: 3 customers requesting +20 GPUs each in APAC region (tickets: JIRA-DC-410, 411, 413).

Data / Dashboard links to call out
- Capacity dashboard (prod): https://metrics.internal.redwood/capacity/dedicated (call out peak % and 90th pct token throughput)
- Reservation ledger: Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-DEDICATED-CAPACITY-PLAN)
- Renewal pipeline: Salesforce link (internal) - flagged renewal for AcmeCorp in May (possible +30 GPU ask)

90-day forecast assumptions
- Hosted growth: +12% token volume month-over-month, steady mix toward smaller context lengths (reduces per-token GPU time by ~5%).
- Dedicated bookings: two expected mid-market wins (May/June) that could add 40 GPUs committed. Probability: 60%.
- Hardware supply: delivery lead time for additional A100 units ~8-10 weeks (if spot offers not acceptable).

Recommendation (high level)
1) Approve a short-term reservation buffer: move 8 GPUs from shared -> reserved buffer to cover expected renewals and incoming requests through end of May. Rationale: protects SLAs for 2 medium commitments and 1 enterprise renewal.
2) Autoscaling policy tweak: reduce cooldown from 6m -> 4m for APAC pools to improve ramp-up during morning spikes (APAC customers reported queuing). Add longer cooldown (12m) for scale-down to avoid thrash.
3) Prioritize procurement conversations with hardware partners to secure +40 GPUs potentially required for late Q2. Start LOI this week.

Action items (to confirm in meeting)
- Jordan: validate reservation impact on cost model and update committed cost forecast (ETA: 2026-03-11).
- Priya: test reduced scale-down cooldown on staging (policy id: autoscale-apac-v2) and report latency regressions (ETA: 2026-03-10).
- Evan (SRE): run a 2-hour simulated APAC morning ramp on staging to verify KV cache warmup and sequence length feedback (ETA: 2026-03-12).
- Maya: draft procurement LOI and circulate to finance + supply (ETA: 2026-03-11).
- Sales lead: confirm AcmeCorp intent and publish updated forecast (Sales to update SF by EOD Fri).

Known risks / open questions
- If both expected mid-market wins convert, we will exceed current physical capacity in APAC without procurement. Contingency: temporary routing to other regions (latency impact) or temporary spot bursting with degraded SLA. Need customer sign-off on fallback.
- Autoscale cooldown changes might increase short-term cost; need cost delta estimate pre-approval.
- Hardware lead times could slip further if new OEM supply issues surface. Should we explore alternative GPU types / multi-cloud?

Discussion points for the sync (agenda)
1) Quick numbers (5m): current pool, reservations, utilization.
2) Forecast & probability assumptions (10m): bookings, renewals, hosted growth.
3) Reservation buffer recommendation (10m): pros/cons, cost delta.
4) Autoscaling policy changes (10m): staging results + rollout plan.
5) Procurement next steps (10m): LOI owner, finance approvals, timeline.
6) Risks & fallbacks (5m).
7) Confirm owners & deadlines (5m).

Notes for 1:1 with Jordan after sync (follow-up)
- Walk through cost model lines that change with 8-GPU reservation buffer. Need clear before/after unit economics.
- Ask Jordan to model worst-case: if APAC demand +30 GPUs and procurement delayed by 6 weeks, what customer-facing mitigations available?

Draft talking points for Sales (AcmeCorp renewal)
- We are prepared to reserve capacity to ensure their traffic has dedicated throughput. If they can sign a 12-month commit by May 15, we can guarantee APAC capacity and offer a 7% discount on reserved units.
- If they require immediate capacity and booking is delayed, we will propose a staged activation with part of capacity served from shared pool + 99.5% best-effort SLA for first 30 days.

Random notes / scratchpad (things to remember)
- Check on GPU utilization metric: sample period used by dashboard is 5m rolling average - may underreport short spikes. Consider adding 1m view for next week.
- Follow up with procurement on alternative vendor quotes (NVIDIA A100 vs L40x).
- Confirm whether any customers are switching to quantized model variants that might reduce GPU hours - reach out to solutions-eng.

TODO (personal)
- Prepare short email to Finance summarizing LOI ask and potential budget reallocation.
- Add backup slide for exec sync: "If capacity gap occurs, customer migration plan".
- Update Confluence reservation ledger with proposed buffer and link to this doc.

-- end --
